## Woolly Rhinoceros (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
 N Large animal

**Defense**

 **hp** 180 (12d8+72 plus 12)  
 **Fort** +16 **Ref** +8, **Will** +5  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** gore +19 (2d6+15/19–20)

 **Special Attacks** powerful charge (gore, 8d6+24), trample (1d6+15, DC 26)  

**Statistics**

 **Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +20; **CMD** 30 (34 vs. trip)  
 **Feats** [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (gore), Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (gore), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md)
